2. End-to-End Enterprise Industrial Diagnostics, After-Sales RAG & Agent DevOps Architecture
Four-Pillar Stack: Anansi Self-Healing Crawl MCP ➔ Predictive Maintenance MCP ➔ BuyWise Warranty LangGraph ➔ BrewCode Suite
Pillar A: Self-Healing Crawl MCP (mdowis/anansi)
• Autonomous Selector Repair: Detects layout changes, locates
target fields semantically & persists the repaired selector
• Adaptive Browser Escalation: Starts fast HTTP; silently
switches to headless browser rendering only when required
• Coherent Identity Layer: Matched Chrome TLS fingerprints,
personas & vendor-aware Cloudflare/Akamai/DataDome handling
• Incremental Re-Crawl: Skips unchanged pages + full MCP server
✓ Eliminates weekly scraper maintenance when vendor DOMs change
Pillar B: Vibration Diagnostics (predictive-maintenance-mcp)
• Evidence-Based Condition Monitoring: Signal processing tools
for rotating machinery vibration spectra & envelope analysis
• Automated Fault Triage: Bearing/gear/imbalance fault detection,
ISO-aligned severity assessment & structured diagnostic reports
• Academic & Industrial Rigor: Zenodo DOI 10.5281/zenodo.17611542
• Dual Integration: Standard MCP server (`io.github.LGDiMaggio`)
plus native Claude Code plugin for reliability engineers
✓ Grounds LLM maintenance recommendations in measured spectra
Pillar C: Warranty & Return LangGraph (buywise-agent)
• Multi-Agent State Graph: LangGraph + LangChain + FastAPI
• Specialized Sub-Agents: Policy retrieval, receipt/date window
verification, warranty clause matching & return decision routing
• Local-First Execution: Runs on internal policy documents
without leaking customer order PII to third-party SaaS
• Production Ready: REST API (`FastAPI`) + CI test suite (`v0.1.0`)
• License: Permissive MIT License
✓ Automates L1/L2 RMA, warranty & return eligibility triage
Pillar D: Claude Code DevOps Suite (claude-brewcode)
• Prompt Mods: Type `++r` to expand structured review blocks
before sending; customize via `/placeholder` & plan effort
• brewcode Module: Skill/agent/rule authoring, `semble` semantic
code search, `superreview` multi-angle audits & team setups
• brewdoc & brewtools: Automated doc sync, PDF export, text
compression, secrets scan, SSH deploy & subagent safety guards
• License: Permissive MIT License
✓ Standardizes code review rigor, doc sync & secret scanning
